run_compute_gains: run compute_gains to compute PD gains for the Flexiv Rizon4 from effective inertia
compute_gains_model: compute PD gains for a MuJoCo robot model given its MJCF XML path
compute_gains_path: compute gains for the Flexiv Rizon4 robot using its flexiv_rizon4.xml model file
compute_gains_joints: compute kp and kd gains per joint grouped by actuator class from mass matrix diagonal
compute_gains_saturation: compute gains using saturation angle and damping ratio as tuning parameters
